concept.title: Language detection and fallback
concept.shortdesc: Understand how BPM chooses a supported locale and what happens when the browser language is not supported.

section.title: Supported locales
section.p: BPM supports en, ru, de, zh-CN, fr, and es-ES as first-class interface locales.

section.title: System language
section.p: System language follows the browser language when it matches a supported BPM locale.

section.title: Fallback
section.p: If the browser language is unsupported, BPM falls back to a supported locale rather than showing partial strings.

section.title: Content parity
section.p: Product documentation and screenshots must remain content-equivalent across all six locales, even when UI labels differ by language.
